{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Compute conversion rates within each segment
stratified_rates = df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(level='channel')
stratified_rates.columns = ['paid_search', 'email']
stratified_rates['difference'] = stratified_rates['email'] - stratified_rates['paid_search']

print('Stratified conversion rates and differences by segment:')
print(stratified_rates)

# Compute overall segment proportions (from the full dataset)
segment_proportions = df['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True)
print('\nOverall segment proportions:')
print(segment_proportions)

# Compute weighted average difference
weighted_diff = (stratified_rates['difference'] * segment_proportions).sum()

print(f'\nWeighted average difference (email - paid_search): {weighted_diff}')"}
